content.comment_body: Hello, I have two [product_name] modules set up as master and slave, and they are working properly. I want to network several units together and enable remote monitoring from a PC. I assume an ethernet switch or hub will be necessary for this setup. Ideally, I’d like to achieve online monitoring, because right now I have to disconnect the slave module and connect the PC, which results in losing half of my I/O. Any advice would be much appreciated.

Hello, you are correct, you’ll need a switch. You can look at [url]. [company_name] provides two switches designed for [product_name], available in both 24V and 230V versions. I hope this information is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is operating two [product_name] modules in a master-slave setup and wants to expand the system to connect additional units for remote PC monitoring. Currently, hardware limitations mean that connecting a PC requires disconnecting the slave module, causing loss of I/O. The main concern is not being able to monitor and control simultaneously, which interrupts their workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to network multiple [product_name] modules at the same time and allow consistent remote monitoring from their PC, without losing any I/O functionality while accessing the system.
